game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Parameter Potion: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions. Each round, blizzard sprites strike the larder door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the potions value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the larder door from blizzard sprites in Chimney Roofs: keep the potions meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: potions drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Parameter Potion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parameter Potion' (Week 6 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Chimney Roofs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Chimney Roofs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while potions > 0.
